sql.projectProcessStepEvent.insertEvent: insert into flow.project_process_step_event(project_process_step_id, process_step_event_id, company_event_status_type_id, created_by_id) values(:projectProcessStepId, :processStepEventId, (select initial_company_event_status_type_id from flow.process_step_event where id = :processStepEventId), :createdById)
sql.projectProcessStepEvent.get: select ppse.*, e.event_name from flow.project_process_step_event ppse inner join flow.process_step_event pse on ppse.process_step_event_id = pse.id inner join flow.event e on pse.event_id = e.id where ppse.id = :id
sql.projectProcessStepEvent.getCompanyId: select e.company_id from flow.project_process_step_event ppse inner join flow.process_step_event pse on ppse.process_step_event_id = pse.id inner join flow.event e on pse.event_id = e.id where ppse.id = :sourceId
sql.projectProcessStepEvent.getProjectProces: select a.id, a.size, a.uuid, a.date_created, a.date_modified, a.filename, a.attachment_type_id, a.content_type, a.s3_key, a.archived, substring(filename, '\.([^\.]+)$') as file_extension, ps.process_step_name, ppsa.project_process_step_event_id, pps.id as "projectProcessStepId", pps.main, concat(u.first_name, ' ', u.last_name) AS uploadedBy from flow.project_process_step_event_attachment ppsa inner join flow.attachment a on a.id = ppsa.attachment_id inner join flow.project_process_step_event ppse on ppse.id = ppsa.project_process_step_event_id inner join flow.project_process_step pps on pps.id = ppse.project_process_step_id inner join flow.process_step ps on ps.id = pps.process_step_id inner join flow."user" u ON a.created_by_id = u.id where ppsa.project_process_step_event_id = :projectProcessStepEventId and a.archived is not true order by pps.main desc, pps.date_created desc
